tools.name: find_route
tools.description: Island-hopping route from A to B in the Philippines: legs, usual departure times, notes and a pre-filled link for the traveller to request a quote. No prices, no live availability.

tools.name: send_enquiry
tools.description: Send the traveller's trip plan to Ann for a free quote. ONLY use after the traveller has clearly agreed to share their name and contact details with Hop With Ann. Ann replies within 24 hours (usually the same day) by email or WhatsApp. This does not book or charge anything.

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: Every route Hop With Ann has a page for, with door-to-door time.
